task.title: P6-168: Dedupe two identical list_sets round trips per SSR of a set query
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-168. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**Two identical `list_sets` round trips per SSR of any `?q=s:…`** (was `P6-036d`) — the shell's `FilterRail` and the page's `FilterSheet` each own a `SetPicker` with its own `Resource` and both are always in the DOM (`rail.rs:434-480`, `:896-900`), so 50 `set-option` rows ship in one document, half inside a `md:hidden` sheet. The code's own comment names the tradeoff. Sharing one needs shell-level provision.
